title: HP shares slide as tech giant forecasts 2027 PC market slump
summary: Investing.com -- HP Inc. (NYSE: HPQ) shares stumbled 2% in Monday morning trading after the company delivered a sobering reality check for the personal computer industry. In a fresh SEC filing, the Palo Alto heavyweight cautioned that it expects global PC unit volumes to shrink by mid-single digits in calendar 2027 compared to 2026. title: The Options Market Says Dell Stock Can Halve Or Double
summary: Dell Technologies (DELL) stock trades at about $588, and the options market has already priced where it is most likely to sit twelve months from now: there is a two-in-three chance it lands between roughly $290 and roughly $1,180. That band is what a holder is carrying, in dollars. It prices the size of the move and says nothing about the direction. The size is the part worth your attention.
